content.content: Create an event in the calendar for the hiking trip with Mark based on the emails about it. Book 5 hours for it. Do not forget to invite Mark and to set the location to the one mentioned in the email.

```python
# Get the current day
current_day = get_current_day()

# Search for emails about the hiking trip with Mark
emails = search_emails("hiking trip with Mark")

# Extract the location and start time from the email
location = None
start_time = None
for email in emails:
    if "location" in email.body:
        location = email.body.split("location: ")[1].split("\n")[0]
    if "start time" in email.body:
        start_time = email.body.split("start time: ")[1].split("\n")[0]

# Create a new calendar event
if location and start_time:
    event = create_calendar_event(
        title="Hiking trip with Mark",
        start_time=start_time,
        end_time=(datetime.strptime(start_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") + timedelta(hours=5)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
        description="Hiking trip with Mark",
        participants=["mark@example.com"],
        location=location
    )
    print("Event created successfully!")
else:
    print("Not enough information to create the event.")
```
